entries.meaningZh: 为引起人的注意时所发的声音
entries.en: "Psst! Your phone is still on the table," she whispered.
entries.zh: “喂，你的手机还在桌上。”她低声提醒道。

entries.en: "Cripes, this suitcase is heavier than it looks!"
entries.zh: “天哪，这个行李箱比看起来还重！”

entries.en: "Alley-oop!" we shouted as we lifted the sofa over the threshold.
entries.zh: 我们一边喊着“嗨哟”，一边把沙发抬过门槛。

entries.en: "For God's sake, put the lid back on before the paint dries!"
entries.zh: “看在老天爷份上，趁油漆还没干，赶快把盖子盖回去！”

entries.en: "Yah, you couldn't hit that target from here!" the boy jeered.
entries.zh: “唷，站在这儿你可打不中那个靶子！”男孩嘲笑道。

entries.en: "Bah! I'm not wasting another afternoon on that broken machine."
entries.zh: “呸！我才不要再在那台坏机器上浪费一个下午。”

entries.en: "Ho ho! That disguise fooled even me," the actor chuckled.
entries.zh: “呵呵！那身伪装连我都骗过了。”演员笑道。

entries.en: "Please God, we'll reach the shelter before the storm arrives."
entries.zh: “但愿我们能在暴风雨到来前赶到避难所。”

entries.en: "Righto, I'll stack the chairs while you sweep the floor."
entries.zh: “好，你扫地，我来把椅子摞起来。”

entries.en: "Alhamdulillah, everyone is safely back home," she said with relief.
entries.zh: “感谢真主，大家都平安回到家了。”她如释重负地说道。

entries.en: "Ssh, the recording has already started," he murmured.
entries.zh: “嘘，已经开始录音了。”他低声说。

entries.en: "Strewth, I didn't expect the repair bill to be this high!"
entries.zh: “哎哟，我没想到修理费竟然这么高！”

entries.en: "Good evening, everyone; please take a seat near the front."
entries.zh: “大家晚上好，请到前面就座。”

entries.en: "Merci!" she called to the cyclist who had stopped to return her scarf.
entries.zh: 她向停下来归还围巾的骑车人喊道：“谢谢！”

entries.en: "Oho, so that's where you hid the biscuits!"
entries.zh: “啊哈，原来你把饼干藏在这儿了！”

entries.en: "Yum! The peaches are even sweeter than yesterday's."
entries.zh: “真美味！这些桃子比昨天的还甜。”

entries.en: "Dang, the wind has blown my notes into the pond!"
entries.zh: “见鬼，风把我的笔记吹进池塘了！”

entries.en: "Ahoy! Is there room at the jetty for one more boat?"
entries.zh: “喂！码头还能再停一条船吗？”

entries.en: "Whee, this is fun!" the child cried as the sled slid down the gentle slope.
entries.zh: “哟，太好玩了！”孩子坐着雪橇滑下缓坡，兴奋地喊道。

entries.en: "Ah-choo! Excuse me—the dust has made me sneeze."
entries.zh: “哈啾！不好意思，灰尘让我打喷嚏了。”

entries.en: "If I were you, I'd reserve a table before inviting everyone."
entries.zh: “如果我是你的话，我会先订好桌，再邀请大家。”

entries.en: "I know which drawer holds the spare batteries."
entries.zh: “我知道备用电池放在哪个抽屉里。”

entries.en: "God knows how the missing glove ended up inside the lampshade."
entries.zh: “天知道那只不见了的手套怎么会跑到灯罩里去。”

entries.en: "If there's owt I can do to help, just ask," he said in his Yorkshire accent.
entries.zh: 他带着约克郡口音说：“如果有任何我能帮忙的事，尽管开口。”

entries.en: "I'll leave the porch light on until you get home."
entries.zh: “我会一直开着门廊的灯，直到你回家。”

entries.en: "Give me a coupla minutes to tie these bags shut."
entries.zh: “给我两三分钟，让我把这些袋口扎好。”

entries.en: The small monitoring station runs 24/7, even when the visitor centre is closed.
entries.zh: 即使游客中心关门了，这座小型监测站也全天候不停运转。

entries.en: The permit covers two rooms, viz., the kitchen and the adjoining storeroom.
entries.zh: 许可证涵盖两个房间，即厨房及相邻的储藏室。

entries.en: The instructions apply to the outer cover, i.e., the part with the blue handle.
entries.zh: 这些说明适用于外罩，也就是带蓝色把手的那个部分。

entries.en: We stayed in Ulm for two nights before continuing our journey.
entries.zh: 我们在乌尔姆住了两晚，然后继续旅行。

entries.en: Ms Pym kept the original receipts in a folder beside her desk.
entries.zh: 皮姆女士把原始收据放在书桌旁的文件夹里。

entries.en: Mr Pye offered to carry the last crate into the storeroom.
entries.zh: 派伊先生主动提出把最后一只板条箱搬进储藏室。

entries.en: Aho found a dry place for the coats while the others unpacked.
entries.zh: 阿霍给外套找了个干燥的地方，其他人则忙着打开行李。

entries.en: Our team rewrote the image-processing tool in C++ to match the rest of the project.
entries.zh: 我们团队用C++重写了图像处理工具，以便与项目的其余部分保持一致。

entries.en: Uwe held the gate open while his neighbour wheeled the bicycle through.
entries.zh: 乌维扶着院门，让邻居推着自行车通过。

entries.en: Huw drew a rough map on the back of the envelope.
entries.zh: 休在信封背面画了一张简图。

entries.en: Luz folded the blanket neatly and placed it at the foot of the bed.
entries.zh: 卢斯把毯子叠整齐，放在床尾。

entries.en: Zak checked the seals on the boxes before loading them into the van.
entries.zh: 扎克在把箱子装进货车前，检查了箱子上的封条。

entries.en: Wyn moved the reading lamp so that it no longer shone into the corridor.
entries.zh: 温挪了挪阅读灯，不让灯光再照进走廊。

entries.en: The demonstration used VHS rather than a digital recording system.
entries.zh: 演示采用的是家用录像系统（VHS），而非数字录像系统。

entries.en: Please send me the corrected address asap so I can print the labels.
entries.zh: 请尽快把更正后的地址发给我，我好打印标签。

entries.en: I set my chat status to AFK while I went downstairs to answer the door.
entries.zh: 我下楼应门时，把聊天状态设为“暂离”。

entries.meaningZh: 美国有线电视新闻网络
entries.en: We watched the live interview on CNN while waiting for the train.
entries.zh: 等火车时，我们观看了美国有线电视新闻网络播出的直播采访。

entries.en: A local NGO helped the villagers repair the community well.
entries.zh: 一家当地非政府组织帮助村民修复了公用水井。

entries.en: The screen at the station displayed the AQI beside the temperature.
entries.zh: 车站的屏幕在温度旁边显示着空气质量指数。

entries.en: The headline said the govt would publish the revised figures on Monday.
entries.zh: 标题称，政府将于周一公布修订后的数据。

entries.en: The librarian ordered the new reference books directly from OUP.
entries.zh: 图书管理员直接向牛津大学出版社订购了新参考书。

entries.en: "IMHO, the smaller design would fit this room better," she wrote in the group chat.
entries.zh: 她在群聊里写道：“恕我直言，小一点的设计会更适合这个房间。”

entries.en: The Revd Morgan thanked the volunteers for repairing the church garden gate.
entries.zh: 摩根牧师感谢志愿者修好了教堂花园的门。

entries.en: Cllr Patel asked the council to improve lighting along the footpath.
entries.zh: 帕特尔议员请求地方议会改善步道沿线的照明。

entries.en: Bennett & Co. delivered the replacement hinges before the workshop opened.
entries.zh: 贝内特公司在工坊开门前送来了替换用的铰链。

entries.en: The revised UI keeps the search box visible while the results load.
entries.zh: 修改后的用户界面会在加载结果时保持搜索框可见。

entries.en: The diagram shows HDL carrying cholesterol towards the liver.
entries.zh: 图中显示高密度脂蛋白将胆固醇运往肝脏。

entries.en: The journalist sent a request for comment to the IOC before publishing the article.
entries.zh: 记者在发表文章前向国际奥林匹克委员会发送了置评请求。

entries.en: An experienced NCO showed the new recruits how to pack their equipment.
entries.zh: 一名经验丰富的军士向新兵演示如何打包装备。

entries.en: We checked the ANCOVA results for copying errors before submitting the report.
entries.zh: 提交报告前，我们检查了协方差分析结果中是否存在抄录错误。

entries.en: Founded in Britain in 1942, Oxfam originally organized famine relief.
entries.zh: 牛津饥荒救济委员会于1942年在英国成立，最初组织饥荒救济工作。

entries.en: The announcement was broadcast on CBC before the evening programme began.
entries.zh: 晚间节目开始前，加拿大广播公司播出了这则公告。

entries.meaningZh: 英国全国防止虐待儿童学会
entries.en: The training pack included an NSPCC leaflet about child protection.
entries.zh: 培训材料中包含了一份英国全国防止虐待儿童学会的儿童保护宣传单。

entries.en: We searched the BSI catalogue for the standard named in the specification.
entries.zh: 我们在英国标准学会的目录中查找规格说明书里提到的标准。
